ambient_k.reason: cold-system starting temperature, room temperature scale (D-CORE-004)

cold_ticks.reason: about 10 minutes to cold, at 10 ticks per second

heat_ticks.reason: game tuning of the start-up step (D-CORE-004)

inject_ticks.reason: game tuning of the start-up step (D-CORE-004)

depressurize_ticks.reason: time for the chamber pressure to fall after a shutdown (D-SAFE-001)

pressurize_ticks.reason: game tuning of the start-up step (D-CORE-004)

matter_min.reason: matter injectors needed for full flow; the rest dilate (D-WARP-003 rule, count is game tuning) (D-CORE-004)

anti_min.reason: antimatter nozzles needed for full flow; D-WARP-003 covers the matter nozzles only, so this redundancy is game tuning (D-WARP-004 gives 3 nozzles) (D-CORE-004)

constrictor_floor.reason: output left with a fully damaged constrictor (D-CORE-004)

ratio_floor.reason: output factor at worst ratio error (D-CORE-004)

ratio_penalty.reason: output loss per unit of relative ratio error (D-CORE-004)

align_floor.reason: output factor in warp mode with no alignment (D-CORE-004)

align_loss_per_warp.reason: alignment lost per warp factor changed (D-CORE-004)

aux_startup_mw.reason: EPS draw while heating, injecting or pressurizing (D-CORE-004)

aux_power_min.reason: delivered share that counts as powered (D-CORE-004)

eject_aux_min.reason: delivered share needed for core ejection (D-CORE-003 offline case) (D-CORE-004)

ff_decay_ticks.reason: time for an unpowered forcefield to fall (D-CORE-004)

ff_hold.reason: strength needed to contain a breach (D-CORE-004)

endurance_ticks.reason: 3 years at 10 ticks per second, at nominal power

nominal_mw.reason: cruise power drawn from the main tank (core plus main impulse, measured 1,818 MW at cruise) so that a full 62,500 m3 deuterium load lasts about 3 years: 3 y x 365 x 86,400 s x 10 ticks/s = 946,080,000 ticks; burn per tick = power / 1,820 MW x 62,500 m3 / 946,080,000 (D-FUEL-009)

aux_endurance_ticks.reason: 24 hours at nominal saucer power, game tuning (D-IMP-005)

containment_decay.reason: containment lost per tick without power (D-FUEL-001)

containment_regain.reason: containment regained per tick with power (D-FUEL-001)

containment_collapse.reason: pods reuse the 15% field collapse level of D-CORE-002; automatic ejection (D-SAFE-005) (D-FUEL-005)

pod_leak_m3.reason: m3 per tick lost by a pod at zero integrity (D-FUEL-005)

ticks_per_hour.reason: unit conversion at 10 ticks per second (ADR 0001) (D-FUEL-013)

generator_mw.reason: EPS draw of the antimatter generator, game tuning (D-FUEL-013)

full_flow_level.reason: loop level (percent) above which cooling flow is full (D-COOL-003)

max_leak.reason: percent of the loop lost per tick at zero integrity (D-COOL-003)

refill_rate.reason: percent per tick moved from the reserve (D-COOL-003)

reserve.reason: percent of one loop held in reserve (D-COOL-003)

heat_gen.reason: core heat per tick per unit of load (D-COOL-003)

core_cool_k.reason: core heat removed per tick per degree over ambient at full flow (D-COOL-003)

eps_heat_gen.reason: conduit heat per tick per load squared (D-COOL-003)

eps_cool_k.reason: conduit heat removed per tick per degree at full flow (D-COOL-003)

cruise_level.reason: displayed shield level at cruise; the cruise draw is the nominal 1,152 MW of D-SHLD-011

cruise_gens.reason: 1,152 MW cruise graviton load / 384 MW per generator

reduced_gens.reason: one generator at reduced power, game tuning (D-EPS-003)

yellow_standby_level.reason: partial standby of the secondary generators at yellow alert (D-MODE-004), fraction is game tuning (D-MODE-004)

freq_range.reason: frequency and modulation are integers 0..999, game scale (D-SHLD-018)

fall_rate.reason: facing level lost per tick when above the level the grid can hold (D-SHLD-012)

regen.reason: facing level regained per tick at full power (D-SHLD-018)

shot_drain.reason: facing level removed by a shot at full adaptation (D-BORG-003)

drain_floor.reason: share of the drain that lands even with no adaptation (D-BORG-001)

adapt_step.reason: frequency and modulation the Borg close per shot (D-BORG-002)

match_width.reason: mean setting distance at which the Borg match is lost (D-BORG-002)

cruise_per_hull.reason: at least 1 active generator per hull in cruise

safe_impulse.reason: impulse fraction counted as inertially safe while the SIF ladder is at level 2 or 3 (D-SIF-017) (D-DMG-001)

inertial_cap.reason: 3 g survivable against over 1,000 g at full impulse

min_field.reason: field strength below which impulse is capped (D-SIF-014)

cruise_per_hull.reason: at least 2 active generators per hull in cruise

lag_ticks.reason: 295 ms rounded to 3 ticks of 100 ms

nac_exponent.reason: nacelle load grows with this power of warp factor / 9.6 (D-CORE-004)

nac_mw_max.reason: load per nacelle at warp 9.6, game-sized; cube law below (D-CORE-004)

nac_collapse_pf.reason: delivered share of nacelle power below which warp collapses (D-CORE-004)

nav_warp_fraction.reason: share of normal output needed up to warp 8

nav_fraction_until.reason: the 80% figure holds up to warp 8

nav_high_fraction.reason: above warp 8 the ledger gives no share; the 80% is kept as a game choice (D-NAVD-008)

nav_gens_2_above.reason: a second generator runs above warp 8

nav_gens_3_above.reason: a third generator runs above warp 9.2

impulse_max_mw.reason: impulse drive load at full normal impulse; canon figure D-IMP-003 does not fit the grid (D-IMP-009)

per_damage_ticks.reason: extra ticks per missing integrity point (D-DMG-001)

core_frac_cruise.reason: core setting at cruise as a share of maximum (D-EPS-003)

impulse_cruise_mw.reason: main impulse setting at cruise: carries ship power if the core goes down (D-SAFE-002) (D-EPS-003)

reduced_impulse_mw.reason: minimum main impulse that covers onboard use (D-MODE-012), game-sized (D-EPS-003)

priorities.reason: consumer priorities per mode, lower number = served first; shed lowest priority first (D-EPS-003) (D-EPS-003)

initial_damage.reason: integrity removed when the scenario starts (62 left) (D-CORE-005)

fault_rate.reason: integrity lost per tick while the containment fault runs; critical after about 220 ticks (D-CORE-005)

impulse_setting.reason: main impulse output at the start: the core carries the load (D-COOL-003)

leak_damage.reason: integrity removed from the core coolant loop at start (D-COOL-003)

time_limit.reason: ticks before the scenario is lost (D-COOL-003)

cool_temp.reason: core temperature at or below which the core counts as cool (90% of the overload temperature) (D-COOL-003)

hold_ticks.reason: ticks the core must stay cool and stable to win (D-COOL-003)

attack_start.reason: tick at which the cube locks on (D-BORG-003)

drain_below.reason: mean shield level below which the cube starts draining ship power (D-BORG-004)

recover_above.reason: mean shield level above which the power drain recedes (D-BORG-004)

power_drain_rate.reason: share of core and main impulse output drained per tick (D-BORG-004)

collapse_strength.reason: mean shield level counted as collapsed (D-BORG-004)

collapse_supply.reason: delivered share of wanted power counted as collapsed (D-BORG-004)

collapse_hold.reason: ticks both must hold to lose (D-BORG-004)

notes: Every value object carries a ledger id (docs/sources.md) or estimate with a one-line reason; see ADR 0002.
